verdict.rationale: Fedora Workstation documents single-command installation of the packages, tools and runtimes developers need, plus container tooling that needs no setup, a Container Toolbox image, and development guides. A community user also reports turning it into a full Python workstation quickly. However, the evidence never shows preconfigured, framework-specific environments, so developers still assemble their own stacks from packages and containers. Missing for 10: documented preconfigured environments or templates for popular frameworks and languages, evidence that Toolbox delivers ready-made language stacks, and broader hands-on corroboration beyond one Python anecdote.
